t: Charged Porters are portable teleportation tools that use $(l:rftoolsbase:machines/matter_receiver)Matter Receivers$(/l) as destinations. They must be charged with FE before use.
充能搬运器是便携式传送工具，以$(l:rftoolsbase:machines/matter_receiver)物质接收器$(/l)作为目的地。使用前必须先以FE为其充能。
Right-click a porter on a Matter Receiver to store that destination. The basic porter stores one target; the advanced porter can store multiple targets and cycle between them.
对搬运器右键点击物质接收器，即可储存该目的地。基础搬运器仅能储存一个目标；高级搬运器则可储存多个目标并循环切换。
Use the charged porter to start teleporting. The receiver must still exist and be usable. The advanced porter is better for players who travel between several bases.
使用已充能的搬运器即可启动传送。接收器必须依然存在且可用。对于需在多个基地间往返的玩家，高级搬运器更为适用。
The Teleport Probe helps inspect receiver information and porter targets, which is useful when debugging a larger teleporter network.
传送探测器有助于检查接收器信息与传送者目标，对调试大型传送网络极为有用。
